dateRange.description: Client-side filter on postedAt. "any" keeps all; otherwise only emit jobs posted within the last N days.
dateRange.title: Date Posted

includeOneInTitle.description: Client-side filter. Only emit jobs whose title contains at least one of the given substrings (case-insensitive).
includeOneInTitle.title: Title Must Include One Of

location.description: Optional location filter, e.g. "Sydney NSW" or "Melbourne VIC". Combined with searchTerm to build a /jobs?keywords=&where= URL.
location.title: Location

postCode.description: Optional Australian 4-digit postcode. Appended to the location when constructing the search URL.
postCode.title: Post Code

proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Seek 403s bare datacenter IPs on Apify, so the default enables Apify's free datacenter proxy pool.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

radius.description: Distance in kilometres around the location. Passed as Seek's distance parameter when building a search URL.
radius.title: Radius (km)

requireEmail.description: Client-side filter. Only emit jobs whose description contains at least one email address.
requireEmail.title: Require Email in Description

requireEmailPhone.description: Client-side filter. Only emit jobs whose description contains BOTH an email address AND a phone number.
requireEmailPhone.title: Require Both Email and Phone

requirePhone.description: Client-side filter. Only emit jobs whose description contains at least one phone number.
requirePhone.title: Require Phone in Description

salaryMax.description: Client-side filter. Only emit jobs whose parsed salary min is at most this value.
salaryMax.title: Salary Max (AUD)

salaryMin.description: Client-side filter. Only emit jobs whose parsed salary max is at least this value.
salaryMin.title: Salary Min (AUD)

salaryType.description: Seek salarytype parameter. Controls how the salary range is interpreted on Seek's side.
salaryType.title: Salary Type

scrapeJobDetails.description: Fetch each job's detail page for the full description + extra metadata. Off = listing-card fields only.
scrapeJobDetails.title: Scrape Job Details

searchTerm.description: Optional keyword filter. Used to build a search URL when no searchUrls are supplied.
searchTerm.title: Search Term (Keywords)

searchUrls.description: Seek search URLs. Examples: https://www.seek.com.au/python-jobs, https://www.seek.com.au/jobs?keywords=python&where=Sydney, https://www.seek.com.au/job/91572959 (direct job URL also supported).
searchUrls.title: Search URLs

sortBy.description: Seek sort order applied to the search URL when constructed from keywords/location.
sortBy.title: Sort By

state.description: Optional Australian state filter (e.g. NSW, VIC, QLD). Appended to the location when constructing the search URL.
state.title: State

subclassifications.description: Client-side filter. Only emit jobs whose subClassification name matches one of these values (case-insensitive).
subclassifications.title: Subclassifications

workArrangements.description: Client-side filter. Only emit jobs whose work arrangement matches one of the selected values.
workArrangements.title: Work Arrangements

workTypes.description: Client-side filter. Only emit jobs whose workType matches one of the selected values.
workTypes.title: Work Types
